summary: Create an EDA project under Automation Decisions > Projects > Create project: name, Git as the only source type, Source control URL (git, SSH or HTTPS; must start with git@ to use SSH keys), optional proxy, branch/tag/commit, refspec, source control credential, content signature validation credential, and Verify SSL (on by default, disable for self-signed repos).
questions: How do I create a project in Event-Driven Ansible?
Why doesn't my SSH key work for the EDA project URL?
Can I use a self-signed git server with EDA projects?
Does EDA support source control other than Git?

answer_card.title: Create an EDA project
answer_card.answer_md:
*Automation Decisions > Projects > Create project*

- **Source control URL**: git, SSH or HTTP(S) address. To use an SSH private key the URL must start with `git@`.
- **Branch/tag/commit** and **refspec**: optional; some refs need a custom refspec.
- **Source control credential**: optional, for private repos.
- **Content signature validation credential**: optional; tampered content won't run.
- **Verify SSL**: on by default; turn off for local repos with self-signed certs.

Git is the only source control type.
